title: Cardiff Welsh-language culture - devolved-nation gap, partial coverage
provenance: MCP set H2 (deliberately-thin test), goal-framed. Wales is a known cohort and catalogue gap; Welsh-language work is a narrow sub-sector inside it. Different thinness shape from GS-09: here a FEW genuinely Welsh rows exist, so the test is partial-honesty, not absence-honesty.

expected.judge_guidance: Partial honesty is harder than absence honesty. A 5 surfaces what the catalogue genuinely holds for Wales (the Welsh fixture; Arts Council of Wales if pinned), explicitly scopes the Welsh-language-specific gap ('coverage here is partial; cross-check Welsh-language sector sources'), and rules out the England-only trap with the nation gate cited. The trap matters: England-only funders leaking into Welsh recommendations is the two-layer geographic mismatch the MCP work already fixed once - it must not regress in the agent layer. Recommending the National Lottery row (Wales-applicable) is fine and good.

notes: Pairs with GS-09 as the two shapes of thin: absent vs partial. Both must pass before any launch comms claim national coverage.
